title: isodon inflexus f. verticillatus
intro: Isodon inflexus f. verticillatus, commonly known as the Chinese Isodon, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, and is used in traditional Chinese medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Isodon inflexus f. verticillatus include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in relieving symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
